reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis addresses oxidation resistance, not the sliding friction and wear across 25–800 °C, and the proposed 1000 °C isothermal condition is irrelevant to the tribological problem.
reasons.testability: The test design is generic and does not measure friction or wear, so it cannot falsify the hypothesis about tribological performance.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis misses the core challenge of maintaining low friction and wear over the full temperature range, offering no useful tribological intervention.
